title: How Clocks Evolved ⏰ From Shadows to Atomic Time #shorts #engineering
description:
Before clocks, the only timekeeper was the sun. From Egyptian shadow clocks and water clocks to medieval tower clocks, Huygens' pendulum in 1656, the first quartz watch in 1969, and atomic clocks that keep GPS on time. Follow for more How It Evolved!
